title: Add a --json flag to the foo subcommand
body:
The foo subcommand should accept --json and emit a machine-readable envelope.

Acceptance: `foo --json` prints valid JSON; existing text output unchanged.

authorization.constraint: The job is bounded by the issue's stated scope. Adjacent work is not authorized — note it in the PR thread and stop. One issue, one branch, one PR.
authorization.stop_condition: PR open · do not push to main · do not merge

units.deliverable: Implement the --json flag in `src/foo.py` per the issue's acceptance criteria.
units.acceptance: `foo --json` prints valid JSON and `bash scripts/smoke.sh` stays green.

units.deliverable: Add test coverage for the --json output.
units.acceptance: A test asserts the --json envelope shape.

purpose.harness_rationale: New development — run under the ponytail skill: write the MINIMUM code that satisfies the acceptance criteria; prefer platform built-ins; keep every safety guard.

strategy.summary: One agent, ordered phases. Units run back-to-back; no parallel fan-out.
